1. Internationally Famous Fashion Designer

Recipient of Many Accolades: The Finalists in the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund in July 2008, The Swarovski Award for Womenswear at the CFDA Fashion Awards 2010, The CFDA/Swarovski Award for Accessory Design 2011, The Fashion Star Award at The Fashion Group International Night of Stars 2015 & The 2016 International Designer of Year at the Canadian Arts & Fashion Awards

4. Designed the dresses of First Lady Michelle Obama on several occasions, including during first and second inauguration of President Obama 2012 & 2017
